about.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Technical Lead & Hardware Maker
about.bioP1: I am Abdulrahman Khalid Abdullah Redhwan (ak01redwan), Founder & Technical Lead at Madboot Nova. With 5+ years of software architecture tenure, I specialize in designing scalable digital ecosystems, optimizing high-concurrency databases, and leading agile engineering teams to deliver mission-critical software.
about.bioP2: Graduating with honors in Computer Information Systems from Al-Ahgaff University, my engineering depth spans Laravel 12, Nuxt.js 4, React/Next.js, and .NET Core. Beyond the screen, I am an electro-mechanical maker who designed, wired, and calibrated a fully functional 3-axis CNC milling machine powered by Arduino and G-Code automation.
about.philosophyP1: I treat software architecture as an exact discipline. Code is a liability unless it is reliable, maintainable, and directly serves measurable business objectives. From automating multi-stage CI/CD deployments in under 3 minutes to tuning SQL execution plans, I enforce zero-compromise engineering quality.

tenets.t1Desc: No manual SSH deployments; every push runs automated test suites and zero-downtime atomic rollouts.
tenets.t2Desc: Applying mechanical tolerance rigor to software system boundaries, eliminating race conditions.
tenets.t3Desc: Enforcing Service-Repository patterns, domain-driven boundaries, and strict OpenAPI contracts.
tenets.t4Desc: Empowering cross-functional teams through structured knowledge transfer and empathetic technical leadership.
